question: What comprehensive reward follows from knowing and mastering this mantra?
premises: The knower secures the four aims of life
These aims are held within one's grasp
Joy is experienced both here and in the other world
inference: Knowing this mantra brings mastery of the four aims and joy in this world and the next.
plain_english: Having placed the four aims of life in his hand, he rejoices both here and in the other world.
